name: kglite-visual-frontend
description: Built to static assets and embedded into the Rust binary by rust-embed. Never published to npm, and deliberately carries no `version` field — an unpublished package with a version string is a fourth place this project's version could drift from the three that matter (CLAUDE.md, Commits & releases). Every dependency is pinned EXACT, no caret: the renderer is pre-stable, and it shares version numbers with a non-free package family whose name differs by one scope, so a floating range is an API risk and a licence risk at once. scripts/check_bans.py names and enforces the ban; it also scans this file, so the banned name cannot be written here.
